verdict.score_rationale: The board is comfortably readable with spacious regional grouping and mostly clean, labeled flows, though one overlapping two-way vertical route and several long return paths keep it below effortless fluency.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and label chips have generous clearance, with wide gaps between stages; only a few chips sit directly amid route traffic.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Four tinted, titled regions make placement, lifecycle, execution, and operations ownership immediately distinct, while proximity clearly separates main flows from notes.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Arrowheads, labels, colors, and dashed styling usually clarify direction, but the quota-to-wait-queue route overlays opposing arrows on one vertical line, and the long lifecycle return and destroy routes require extra tracing.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: Main flows, decisions, failure paths, and shared operational context are visibly decomposed, although the oversized canvas and explanatory notes slightly dilute the visual hierarchy.
